original_card.question: Can one exact all-size/compiler, precision, hosting or restoration implication be proved or falsified?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected review scope and choose one exact all-size or precision implication.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write its quantified inputs and conclusion; find a missing hypothesis or construct a minimal exact adversarial instance.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: Choose one tape, precision, hosting or restoration lemma.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.

actual_scope: Restoration interface of the selected #1094 record (common-label/mutable-source realization, per call), for the complex supplier only: the local programs of the selected seven-slot word. (a) Prove that the emitted forward and backward local programs of the selected seven-slot word satisfy Lemma G hypothesis H1 (WellLabelled in extended labels, HPE-aware), and that every word accepted by the pinned PR635 transport and emitter with the pinned routing does so, so that Lean Stream.conj_matrix plus H2 and the exact scalar shadow give per-call realization on C^{2^9} and C^{2^9}⊗V (more generally, on any Q-module where the same operators and recipes satisfy H2) for arbitrary dirty inputs. (b) Show that the selected chain runs no tag check (Lemma G assigns the tag half of H1 to check_extended_labels.py, which cannot run on HPE words; the HPE package maps only G0 in cleanup_tail to audit_local.py, where every operand has tag T) and that its frame-only replay (PR635 hpe_audit_local.py) does not substitute for one: three exact scalar-neutral counterexamples that it accepts (two adapter straddles and a block of exit adapters moved into phase B), with their physical consequences. (c) Run the published Lemma G checker three ways on the selected programs. The bit supplier's common-label/mutable-basis realization is not addressed.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one exact all-size/compiler, precision, hosting or restoration implication. This package picks the restoration implication the selected record retains as 'common-label/mutable-source realization', proves its per-call instance hypothesis H1 for the selected word's complex local programs (and structurally for every word the pinned tools accept), and shows at the same interface boundary that the selected chain runs no tag check and that its frame-only replay does not substitute for one. It names the inherited all-size/compiler, hosting, cross-call composition, bit-supplier, precision/tape and Lemma A (N) obligations instead of discharging them. No construction, kappa or selected file changes.
bottleneck_link: The selected kappa (certificates/selected-result.json) is conditional on retained interfaces that include common-label/mutable-source realization. For the selected word's local programs (the complex supplier), this package reduces the per-call part of that interface to Lean Lemma G plus the H2 recipe pin plus the exact scalar shadow, all bound to committed bytes; it also shows that the selected chain runs no tag check and that its frame-only admission replay would not detect a violation of H1, and recommends hardening. The bit supplier's part of the interface is untouched. kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Stop when H1 is decided on both selected programs regenerated from committed bytes and proved for every word the pinned transport and emitter accept; when the three counterexamples are exact (accepted by the pinned frame-only replay, rejected by both label checkers, physical consequence with explicit witnesses); when the label checker's failure controls are pinned and every single-clause weakening of it is caught or shown redundant; and when the published Lemma G checker has been run three ways. Do not attempt the Lean build, the all-size compiler, hosting, cross-call composition, the bit supplier or a new construction.
evidence: verify.py (standard library, about 85 s per command, two registered commands) regenerates canonical payload 4ddb29fb, programs 071ecdac/f36c5831 and CLIFFORD-RECIPES d0768f21 from committed bytes and checks them against SLOT-PINS-k8 and the #1094 PLAN registry. Independent HPE-aware extended-label checker: 0 violations in both orientations (24,767 events each; 1,497 forward and 3,924 backward source writes; 5 of 8 centres are sources; 240 wrapped helpers including 48 cold HPE). Exact scalar shadow re-derived. Checker controls: 28 forward and 27 backward edits rejected under both readings plus one strict-only edit, all counts pinned; 31 of 32 single-clause weakenings of the checker change a pinned value, and the survivor (source entry adapter at start_i) is implied by the source-entry label clause. Three scalar-neutral mutants of the forward program (exit straddle of target 112 at frame 778; entry straddle of source 0 at frame 9; the 113 exit adapters of registers 0..112 moved before event 15487 in phase B) are accepted by the pinned hpe_audit_local.py (exit 0, PASS, 25 controls) and rejected by both label checkers (permissive/strict 2/4, 2/2, 113/113; patched Lemma G checker 4, 4, 113 uncapped) and by the recommended adapter rule (2, 2, 114 events). Physical consequences proved with witnesses N_t e0 = i^3 e11 (executed exit N_t^-1 e0 = i^3 e1), M_0 e1 = i e10, and h_48 = M_48^-1 T_155 T_778^-1 e_0 for the moved block (honest target 112 ends at 0, the mutant's at (i^3 e_1 - e_0)/2); all 224 endpoint adapters are non-identity monomials. Published check_extended_labels.py (previously run only by #509 and #516, never on an HPE word): parse failure on 5-field HPE wrapper events; 96 violations per orientation with the 5th field stripped (the list it returns is capped at 50); the patched copy gives 0 and still rejects its own 5 mutants (12, 1, 1, 43, 1). All numbers are pinned in EXPECTED.json. The Lean build is not re-run.

open_questions.question: Can the selected local replay admit only extended-label well-labelled programs, by running an HPE-aware extended-label check next to the frame-only hpe_audit_local.py?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The three mutants show that the current admission check accepts programs whose physical output differs from the Lemma G formula. Forbidding scalar events in entry_adapters and exit_adapters would not close the gap: the moved exit-adapter block has no scalar there. The pinned emitter cannot produce the mutants, so kappa is unaffected, but a future emitter change could pass admission while breaking restoration.
open_questions.first_step: Add label_check from this package's verify.py (or the patched Lemma G checker) as a stage of the selected replay, with the three mutants as negative controls; keep frozen vendored scripts unchanged and add the stage in a new wrapper. A cheaper rule (every data adapter and wrapper in its own phase at cur[r] == f, and per-register adapter state: no scalar or climb on a source before its entry adapter or on a target after its exit adapter; adapter_rule in verify.py) rejects all three but would first need a proof that it implies H1.
open_questions.blocked_by: A maintainer decision on where the selected replay chain may gain a stage; frozen vendored scripts cannot be edited in place.

open_questions.question: Does the per-call realization compose across calls, i.e. do data phases (exit N_t^-1 of one call, entry M_i of the next, and the data adapters between them) compose to the intended multi-call transform?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Theorem 1 here is per call. The selected record also relies on composing data phases across calls, which this package names as inherited and does not prove.
open_questions.first_step: State the two-call composition in Lemma G's event model (concatenate two calls' streams with the data adapters between them) and check which junction conditions wellLabelled_append needs.
open_questions.blocked_by: A precise statement of the cross-call data-phase interface in the selected review.
